{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling potential errors
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors (NaN values)
print(sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows after conversion
print(sales_df.head())"}
